body.statement:
For \(\vartheta>0\), the positive infinitely divisible random variable
\[
 W_\vartheta=\int_{(0,1]}u\,N_\vartheta(du),
 \qquad N_\vartheta(du)\text{ having intensity }\vartheta\,du/u,
\]
has the generalized Dickman distribution with parameter \(\vartheta\).

source.locator: Section 1, generalized Dickman distribution and its Poisson-process representation
source.verbatim_statement: It is well known that the sum of points of $\eta_c$ lying in the interval $(0,1)$ is distributed as a generalized Dickman random variable $D_c$. In particular, $D_c =_d \int_0^1 t\,\eta_c(dt)$, where $\eta_c$ is the scale-invariant Poisson process with intensity density $ct^{-1}$.

upstream.citation: Bhattacharjee and Molchanov (2020), Convergence to scale-invariant Poisson processes and applications in Dickman approximation, EJP 25 paper 79, DOI 10.1214/20-EJP482
upstream.locator: Section 1, page 3, displayed identity following the generalized Dickman fixed-point definition

attestation.note: The cited Bhattacharjee--Goldstein 2019 Section 1 gives the generalized Dickman fixed-point definition but does not state this continuous Poisson-process identity. Exact identity verified instead in the lawful source text of Bhattacharjee--Molchanov 2020, EJP 25 paper 79, Section 1 / page 3, DOI 10.1214/20-EJP482, on 2026-09-13.
